# Ridealong

> Ridealong is an open-source MCP server for Claude Code that drives a real Google Chrome and streams it live (GPU-encoded H.264). The human can watch, point at elements, pause, approve sensitive actions, or take the wheel from a phone; the agent gets console errors, network requests, real tabs and stable element refs. MIT.

Key facts
- Category: MCP server, browser automation, human-in-the-loop AI agents.
- Works with: Claude Code (stdio MCP); any MCP client for the tools. Instant messages/approvals use Claude Code channels.
- Runs: locally (one command), Docker, or an always-on server with a tunnel.
- Browser: real Google Chrome via CDP, dedicated profile, HTTP cache and service workers bypassed.
- Live view: H.264 (NVENC / VideoToolbox / libx264) or JPEG; 720p to 2K; Claude's cursor; journal; pause; approval cards; pointer hints; messages; real tabs; Manual mode with no capture.
- Security: HMAC-signed expiring links in the URL fragment; 30-day device tokens; loopback by default; Manual-mode input never stored, logged or shown to the model.
- Tools: navigate, reload, state, snapshot, find, read, diff, screenshot, console_errors, act, fill, scroll, network_requests, fetch_with_session, tabs_list, tabs_open, tabs_select, tabs_close, live_start, live_mode, live_stop, ask_approval, inbox.
